name: @wren/admin
description: WREN Writing Coach Admin_Service (Node 22). Organization groupings and the configurable, self-selectable Writing Type catalog: CRUD plus OPEN/LOCKED access-state control at the Organization and Writing Type levels. All privileged operations re-check the @wren/auth capability matrix server-side and deny with no mutation; all persistence uses the @wren/db-node parameterized data-access layer (REQ-ORG-GROUPING-01, REQ-ORG-CONFIG-01, REQ-ADMIN-FEATURES-01).
